You will evaluate and test various embedding models and frameworks, applying prompt engineering, grounding, and hallucination mitigation techniques to improve AI accuracy and safety. Building API\-driven services using FastAPI and integrating them with databases such as MongoDB and Redis, as well as front\-end frameworks like Angular or React, will be part of your duties. Additionally, you will develop utilities, automation frameworks, and data pipelines to support AI/ML and GenAI initiatives.
